name: edgeping
description: Edge-of-screen strip and sound when a Claude Code conversation in another VS Code window finishes or asks you something. For Claude Code on macOS; not affiliated with Anthropic.

sound_enabled.title: Sound
sound_enabled.description: Play a sound when a conversation finishes or asks you something.

strip_enabled.title: Edge strip
strip_enabled.description: Show a strip on the edge of the screen, next to the window of the conversation.

sound_done.title: Sound when done
sound_done.description: Sound played when a conversation finishes.

sound_question.title: Sound when asking
sound_question.description: Sound played when a conversation asks you something.

color_done.title: Color when done
color_done.description: Strip color for a finished conversation, as #RRGGBB.

color_question.title: Color when asking
color_question.description: Strip color when a conversation asks you something, as #RRGGBB.

duration_seconds.title: Strip duration (seconds)
duration_seconds.description: How long the strip stays on screen, from 3 to 60 seconds. Ignored when Stay until visited is on.

stay_until_visited.title: Stay until visited
stay_until_visited.description: When on, the strip stays until you stop on the window's screen for about a second, and the duration is ignored.

label_enabled.title: Label
label_enabled.description: Show a text label on the strip.
